troubleshooting.solution: Write to Cd (Color) attribute for visibility.
Change Type menu (sine, cos, triangle, square, easeIn/Out/InOut).
Set Parameter Size to 3 for independent X/Y/Z control.

description: Generator that creates line strip shapes or modifies attributes using elementary math functions (sine, cosine, triangle, square, ease in/out, random). Supports Parameter Size 1-4 for per-component curves, cyclic mode, line breaks per cycle, and texture coordinate generation.
